question: Elements were classified on the basis of their _________

options.text: different physical as well different chemical properties
different physical but same chemical properties

solution:
The correct answer is __**different physical as well different chemical properties**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Mendeleev's Periodic Law: The physical and chemical properties of elements are periodic functions of their atomic masses.

 
 
• Mendeleev arranged all the elements known at that time in increasing order of atomic mass and this arrangement became a periodic table.
 
• In Mendeleev's Periodic Table: The total number of periods in the periodic table was seven and the total number of groups was nine.
